intro.title: Polling Hook
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a custom React hook called `usePolling` that automatically fetches data from an API at regular intervals. You will learn how to use the `useState` and `useEffect` hooks to manage state and side effects in a functional component. The main technologies involved are React hooks, JavaScript's `setInterval` for timing, and the `fetch` API for data retrieval. By the end, you'll have a reusable hook that can be integrated into any component to enable real-time data updates through polling.
intro.usecase: Polling hooks are essential for building real-time dashboards that display live data updates without requiring manual page refreshes. In financial trading platforms, polling hooks continuously fetch stock price changes to keep charts and portfolios current. E-commerce admin panels use polling to monitor order status changes and inventory levels as they happen. Live sports score trackers implement polling to update game statistics and scores in real-time for viewers.
